recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed unless OO makes a new device/BDP identifier decision that explicitly reintroduces UDI-DI or distinct identification support.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core BiologicallyDerivedProduct asking to add optional BiologicallyDerivedProduct.udiDeviceIdentifier and a distinct identification string for HCT/P products regulated as devices.
initial_application: The original request was applied in source history: commit 18bb2a4bba68248dbacd0dc15f88cd0df2cd5fe8 added BiologicallyDerivedProduct.udiDeviceIdentifier and BiologicallyDerivedProduct.distinctIdentifier, and Jira-linked PR #1569 commit cc323ba311bded7d1e17c6d356bc8fdf9b3d1b24 added UDI mapping metadata.
additional_context: FHIR-35967 later removed BDP udiDeviceIdentifier as added or left by accident, and FHIR-35968 later removed BDP distinctIdentifier because it was meant to be replaced by biologicalSource rather than left as a parallel element. Both later issues are Published/Persuasive, applied for R5, and already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding either FHIR-20560 element would contradict the later final OO removal decisions, and the active current BDP StructureDefinition has no udiDeviceIdentifier or distinctIdentifier residue.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive R5 correction removing the BDP udiDeviceIdentifier element added by FHIR-20560; already represented on the combined branch by 847aea46538369d075d2705750c9b16c885de51e.
Later Published/Persuasive R5 correction removing the BDP distinctIdentifier element added by FHIR-20560; already represented on the combined branch by bd4446a16792c9a07735ea555875dbe87838f64c.
